headlines.title: Heathrow Airport warns third runway could be delayed by four years
headlines.description: The UK's busiest airport cautions it may miss the government target of 2035 as ministers say the deadline has "always been ambitious".

headlines.title: Sir David Beckham nets £38.5m after World Cup ad deals
headlines.description: His stake in DRJB Holdings has entitled him to almost half of its £85.5m in dividend payments.

headlines.title: UK diesel price close to all-time high
headlines.description: The average price of a litre of diesel at the pump stands at 198.32p, according to the RAC motoring body.

headlines.title: Rolls-Royce signs 'multi-million' engine deal
headlines.description: The order will see 18 engines built and maintained by the company from its Derby aerospace centre.

headlines.title: Trump reveals millions of dollars' worth of share deals in big tech and AI
headlines.description: Stock in major firms such as Microsoft, Nvidia and SpaceX was bought and sold on behalf of the US president.
